notes.title: DEMO RELEASING TOMMOROW!!!
notes.content:
[h3]The Demo Is finally releasing (FOR REAL THIS TIME) on the 27th.[/h3][p]Soon you'll be able to give us feedback and ideas for what we need to improve.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613451/86b5b3fdbe2157768e20ed87119f4c46efb8c80d.png"][/img][/p][p]Jerry the Ackloid[/p][p]||[/p][p]||[/p][p]||[/p][p]\\/

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613451/d1e6702467b51f47b5ba7e96987e39a56e09086b.gif"][/img]<This is quite exciting!!![/p][p]

[/p][p]I am VERY excited to hear what you all think, and I really want your feedback.
